description: Test file for defaulting functions in Kubernetes apps/v1beta2 API, including tests for DaemonSet, StatefulSet, Deployment, and ReplicaSet defaulting behaviors.

methods.name: TestSetDefaultDaemonSetSpec
methods.description: Tests defaulting behavior for DaemonSet specifications, including labels, update strategy, and revision history limit.

methods.name: TestSetDefaultStatefulSet
methods.description: Tests defaulting behavior for StatefulSet specifications, including labels, update strategy, pod management policy, and revision history limit.

methods.name: TestSetDefaultDeployment
methods.description: Tests defaulting behavior for Deployment specifications, including strategy, revision history, and progress deadline.

methods.name: TestDefaultDeploymentAvailability
methods.description: Verifies that default maxUnavailable value during deployment does not lead to zero active replicas.

methods.name: TestSetDefaultReplicaSetReplicas
methods.description: Tests defaulting of ReplicaSet replicas count based on pod template labels.

methods.name: TestDefaultRequestIsNotSetForReplicaSet
methods.description: Ensures that resource requests are defaulted to zero if not specified in ReplicaSet pod template.

methods.name: roundTrip
methods.description: Serializes and deserializes a runtime.Object to test defaulting and conversion logic.
